scientific_integrity: Classical normalized-exponential sampling and the Plackett–Luce ranking are acknowledged prior results. Originality concerns the unlabeled ratio, finite-jet geometric inversion and sharp triangle distributional bounds; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Supporting hyperplanes rather than finite facets; facet-area profile but not full shape recovered beyond dimension two; exact population derivatives are not finite-sample estimates; definitive historical priority is open.
title: Finite-jet reconstruction of triangle shape from interior facet-distance ratios
